workingLoop.nextStep: Owner review of this connected sample; choose one concrete polish target.
workingLoop.perRound: One visible objective, an explicit file scope and one completion check.
workingLoop.tools: Search/read once; reuse existing art and importers; imagegen only for a named asset gap; add a helper only for an independent task that justifies its cost.
workingLoop.validation: Focused checks first, full verification at the checkpoint; repeat only after a relevant change or failure.
workingLoop.stopRule: After two iterations without a visual improvement, reassess the approach before generating or expanding further.
